notes:
- Top-bar shortcuts and tabs are separate switches: Settings kept both answers in one card called Bottom bar, and turning a top-bar shortcut on also added its tab - turning that tab off then took the shortcut away. Top bar now holds the two shortcuts and Bottom bar holds the two tabs, each switch changes only its own surface, and Search has its own card for the anime and manga halves.
- The bar no longer highlights Home on a tab-less page: opening Tiers or Search from a top-bar shortcut with its tab switched off drew the bar with Home selected. The bar now draws no selected tab on a page that is not one of its destinations.
- The tier board's search says why it is empty: a blank query on an unloaded library used to report that nothing matched an empty pair of quotes. It now says the list has not loaded yet.
- The tier search grid sits in the middle: the nine-poster pages were pinned to the leading edge, leaving dead space on one side. Each row is centred now, including a short last row.
